paragraphs: Brightstar Lottery PLC was organized in 2014 as a public limited company under the laws of England and Wales. The Parent's principal office is located at 2 and 3 Eldon Street, Fifth Floor, London EC2M 7LS, United Kingdom, telephone number +44 (0) 203 866 1240. The Company conducts business through various subsidiaries and variable interest entities (see "Item 4. C. – Organizational Structure"), and the Parent is publicly-traded on the NYSE under the symbol "BRSL".

For a description, including the amount invested, of the Company's principal capital expenditures for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, see "Item 5. Operating and Financial Review and Prospects - B. Liquidity and Capital Resources—Capital Expenditures."
For a description of the Company's principal divestitures for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, see "Item 5. Operating and Financial Review and Prospects - A. Operating Results."

The SEC maintains an internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC at https://www.sec.gov. The Company's SEC filings can be found there and on the Company's website: www.brightstarlottery.com.

The Company is a global leader in lottery focused on innovation and forward-thinking strategies and solutions, building on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a pure-play global lottery company, our best-in-class lottery operations, retail and digital solutions, and award-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, responsibly entertain players, and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. The Company has a well-established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity, and responsibility.

The Company operates and provides an integrated portfolio of innovative lottery solutions, including lottery management services and instant lottery systems. The Company operates a worldwide land-based lottery and iLottery business, including sales, operations, product development, technology, and support, and is a leading iLottery platform provider globally. The Company is supported by central corporate support functions, including finance, people and culture, legal, corporate communications, and strategy and corporate development.

The Company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with principal operating facilities located in Providence, Rhode Island and Rome, Italy. Research and development and product assembly are mostly centralized in North America. The Company had approximately 5,815 employees at December 31, 2025.

The Company has the global scale to complement its geographic and customer diversification, providing B2C and B2B products and services to customers across six continents, supplying a unique set of lottery solutions to nearly 90 customers worldwide, including to 37 of the 48 U.S. lotteries (including the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and U.S. Virgin Islands). Lottery customers frequently designate their revenues for particular purposes, such as education, economic development, conservation, transportation, programs for senior citizens and veterans, health care, sports facilities, capital construction projects, cultural activities, tax relief, and others. Many governments have become increasingly dependent on their lotteries as revenues from lottery ticket sales are often a significant source of funding for these programs.

Land-based lottery products and services are provided through operating contracts, FMCs, LMAs, and product sales contracts. In the majority of jurisdictions, lottery authorities award contracts through a competitive bidding process. Typical service contracts range from five (5) to ten (10) years in duration, often with multiple multi-year extension options. After the expiration of the initial or extended contract term, a lottery authority generally may either seek to negotiate further extensions or commence a new competitive bidding process. From time to time, there are challenges or other proceedings relating to the awarding of the lottery contracts. Upon being awarded a contract, certain customers may require the Company to pay an upfront fee for the right to exclusively manage their lottery.

The Company designs, sells, leases, and operates a complete suite of point-of-sale machines that are electronically linked with a centralized transaction processing system that reconciles lottery funds between the retailer and the lottery authority. The Company provides and operates lottery transaction processing systems that are designed to be secure and capable of processing a significant number of transactions per minute. The Company deploys more than 350,000 point-of-sale devices to lottery customers and lotteries worldwide. The Company also produces high-quality instant ticket games and provides printing services such as instant ticket marketing plans and graphic design, programming, packaging, shipping, and delivery services.

The Company has developed and continues to develop new lottery games and installs a range of new lottery distribution devices, all of which are designed to drive responsible same-store sales growth for its customers.

In connection with its delivery of lottery services, the Company actively advises many of its customers on growth strategies. Depending on the type of contract and the jurisdiction, the Company also provides marketing services, including retail optimization and lottery brand awareness campaigns. The Company works closely with its lottery customers and retailers to help retailers sell lottery games more effectively. These programs include product merchandising and display recommendations, a selection of appropriate lottery product mix for each location, and account reviews to plan lottery sales growth strategies. The Company leverages years of experience accumulated from being the exclusive licensee for the Italian Lotto and the Italian Scratch & Win (Gratta e Vinci) instant ticket lottery, two of the world's largest lotteries. This lottery B2C expertise in Italy, which includes management of all the activities along the lottery value chain, allows the Company to better serve B2B customers.

The Company provides a comprehensive, end-to-end iLottery ecosystem designed to enable government-regulated lotteries to engage players through integrated digital channels. Our iLottery solution is anchored by our proprietary, cloud-based Remote Game Server ('RGS') and our OMNIA™ integrated lottery solution, which facilitate the high-performance delivery of a digital game portfolio comprising over 200 eInstant titles, digital draw games, and premium licensed content. Through our 'Connected Play' initiatives, the Company provides an omnichannel experience that bridges retail and digital environments via universal eWallets, mobile prize claims, and second-chance programs. Furthermore, the Company leverages artificial intelligence and predictive analytics—specifically through its Game Recommendation Engine—to optimize player engagement and personalize content delivery. This digital infrastructure is engineered to meet stringent regulatory requirements across global jurisdictions and incorporates advanced responsible gaming safeguards, including AI-driven monitoring of player behavior, to ensure a secure and compliant operating environment.
Worldwide, the Company currently has 15 Platform customers which also receive either eInstant and/or draw games.

headings: Risks related to the Company's Business and Industry
The Company has a concentrated customer base, and the loss of any of its larger customers (or lower sales from any of these customers) could lead to significantly lower revenue.
The Company's operations are dependent upon its continued ability to retain and extend its existing contracts and win new contracts with its customers.
The lottery industry is a competitive industry, and the Company's success largely depends on its ability to win long-term lottery contracts.
Competition from other forms of comparable entertainment and shifts toward digital channels could adversely affect the Company's business.
The Company is subject to substantial penalties for failure to perform.

The Company's use of artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, and similar technologies could result in reputational harm, competitive harm, legal liability, and adverse effects on results of operations.
If the Company is unable to protect its intellectual property or prevent its unauthorized use by third parties, its ability to compete in the lottery market may be harmed.
If the Company is unable to license intellectual property from third parties, its ability to compete in the lottery market may be harmed.
Third party intellectual property infringement claims against the Company could limit its ability to compete effectively.
The Company's inability to successfully complete, integrate or leverage strategic alliances could limit its future growth or otherwise be disruptive to its ongoing business.
Divestitures may materially adversely affect the Company's financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.
The Company faces reputational risks related to the use of social media.
The Company faces risks related to the extensive and complex governmental regulation applicable to its operations.
Changes to trade regulation, quotas, duties or tariffs may materially adversely affect customer demand for the Company's services and products.
Investigations by governmental and licensing entities can result in adverse findings or negative publicity.
Failure to comply with data privacy laws, including the GDPR could result in significant penalties.
The Company is exposed to significant risks in relation to compliance with anti-corruption laws and regulations and economic sanction programs.
Negative perceptions and publicity surrounding the lottery industry could lead to increased regulation.
Changes to U.S. and foreign tax laws could adversely affect the Company.

The Company may be subject to an unfavorable outcome with respect to pending regulatory, tax, or other legal proceedings, which could result in substantial monetary damages or other harm to the Company.
The Company is subject to physical risks relating to climate change and transitional risks relating to governmental and societal responses to climate change.
The Company depends on its suppliers and faces supply chain risks that could adversely affect its financial results.

The Company and its operations are subject to cyberattacks and cybersecurity risks which may have an adverse effect on its business and results of operations and result in increasing costs to minimize these risks.
Failure to attract, retain and motivate personnel may adversely affect the Company's ability to compete.
The Company's business prospects and future success rely heavily upon the integrity of its employees, directors, and agents.
The success of the Company's business is dependent on customers' confidence in the integrity of the Company's products and systems.
Technology failures may disrupt the Company's business and have an adverse effect on its results of operations.

A substantial portion of the Company's revenues is derived from exclusive licenses awarded to the Company by ADM, the governmental authority responsible for regulating and supervising gaming in Italy. For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, approximately 18%, at both periods, of the Company's total consolidated revenues was earned from services provided for the operation of the Italian Lotto games and approximately 19% and 17%, respectively, was earned from services provided for the operation of the Italian Scratch & Win (Gratta e Vinci) instant ticket games.

The Company expects that a significant portion of its revenues and profits will continue to depend upon the licenses awarded to the Company by ADM. These licenses are not renewable and may be terminated prior to their expiration dates upon the occurrence of certain events of default affecting the Company, or if such licenses are deemed to be against the public interest, or terminated or annulled if successfully challenged by competitors. In addition, the conditions for any new license will be established by law and included in the rules of the new license. Any material reduction in the Company's revenues from these licenses, including as a result of an annulment, early termination, or non-renewal of these licenses following their expiration, has had, and may in the future have, a material adverse effect on the Company's results of operations, business, financial condition, or prospects.

In addition, recurring revenues from the Company's top 10 customers outside of Italy accounted for approximately 35% of its total consolidated revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025. In August 2025, Allwyn UK, one of our historic top ten customers outside of Italy, completed its U.K. lottery system transition to another supplier, thereby resulting in the loss of a customer which accounted for approximately $37 million and $54 million in revenues in 2025 and 2024, respectively.

Furthermore, lower‑than‑expected sales by one or more of the Company's larger customers could materially adversely affect the Company. For example, LMAs include performance‑based incentive mechanisms that may result in the Company earning additional payments if specified contractual metrics are achieved, or incurring shortfall payments if such metrics are not met. In 2025, the change in the incentive payment was reduced by $51 million, mainly due to lower MSJP activity.

If the Company were to lose any of its other larger customers, or if these larger customers experience lower sales and consequently reduced revenues, which are primarily service revenues, there could be a material adverse effect on the Company's results of operations, business, financial condition, or prospects.

paragraphs: Brightstar is a global leader in lottery focused on innovation and forward-thinking strategies and solutions, building on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a pure-play global lottery company, our best-in-class lottery operations, retail, and digital solutions, and award-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, responsibly entertain players, and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. Brightstar has a well‑established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity and responsibility.

The Company operates and provides an integrated portfolio of innovative lottery solutions, including lottery management services and instant lottery systems. The Company operates a worldwide land-based lottery and iLottery business, including sales, operations, product development, technology, and support, and is a leading iLottery platform provider globally. The Company is supported by central corporate support functions including finance, people and culture, legal, corporate communications, and strategy and corporate development.

During 2025, Brightstar Lottery completed its transformation into a pure‑play global lottery operator following the sale of IGT Gaming on July 1, 2025. Our results of operations for the year were principally influenced by (i) the renewal of the Italian Lotto license and the resulting increase in upfront license fee amortization, (ii) lower LMA incentive revenues driven by U.S. multi‑state jackpot activity, (iii) continued growth in instant ticket and draw game sales, and (iv) the execution of the OPtiMa 3 restructuring programs to realign our cost structure.

We ended 2025 with a strong liquidity position, reflecting disciplined capital allocation, debt reduction following the divestiture, and the return of capital to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.

本公司為全球彩券領域的領導者，專注於創新與前瞻性的策略與解決方案，建立在本公司在提供安全科技及生產可靠、完整的解決方案方面的卓越專業經驗之上。作為一家純粹的全球彩券公司，本公司最佳等級的彩券運營、零售與數位解決方案及獲獎的彩券遊戲，使客戶能達成目標，負責任地娛樂玩家，並向社區分發有意義的福利。本公司在當地有穩固的據點，並成為全球各國政府與監管機構的可信任夥伴，透過遵守最高標準的服務、誠信與責任，創造價值。
本公司運營並提供一整套創新彩券解決方案，包括彩券管理服務及即開彩券系統。本公司運營全球性的實體彩券及 iLottery 事業，包括銷售、運營、產品開發、科技與支援，並為全球領先的 iLottery 平台供應商。本公司受到中央企業支援功能的支持，包括財務、人力與文化、法律、企業通訊及策略與企業發展。
本公司總部設於英國倫敦，主要運營設施位於美國羅德島州普羅維登斯及義大利羅馬。研究與開發及產品組裝主要集中在北美地區。本公司於 2025 年 12 月 31 日約有 5,815 名員工。

本公司擁有全球規模，可補足其地理與客戶多元化，為跨六大洲的客戶提供 B2C 及 B2B 產品與服務，向全球近 90 名客戶提供獨特的彩券解決方案，包括美國 48 個州的 37 個彩券機構（包括華盛頓特區、波多黎各及美國維京羣島）。彩券客戶經常指定其收入用於特定用途，例如教育、經濟發展、保育、交通、為長者及退伍軍人設立的計畫、醫療照護、體育設施、基礎建設計畫、文化活動、稅收減免及其他用途。許多政府已越來越依賴其彩券，因為彩券銷售收入通常是這些計畫的重要資金來源。

陸基彩票產品及服務透過營運契約、FMCs、LMAs 及產品銷售契約提供。在大多數司法管轄區，彩票主管機關透過競標程序授予契約。典型服務契約的期限為五 (5) 至十 (10) 年，通常包含多個多年延長選項。在初始或延長契約期滿後，彩票主管機關通常會尋求進一步協商延長，或啟動新的競標程序。有時會有關於授予彩票契約的挑戰或其他程序。當公司獲得了契約，某些客戶可能要求本公司支付一筆 upfront 費用，以取得獨家管理其彩票的權利。
本公司設計、銷售、出租並營運一套完整的零售點銷售機器，這些機器透過電子方式與中央交易處理系統連結，用以調和零售商與彩票主管機關之間的彩票資金。本公司提供並營運設計為安全且能處理大量交易每分鐘的彩票交易處理系統。本公司在全球範圍內部署超過 350,000 臺零售點銷售設備。本公司也生產高品質的即開票遊戲，並提供印刷服務，包括即開票行銷計畫、圖形設計、程式設計、包裝、運送及交付服務。
本公司已開發並持續開發新的彩票遊戲，並安裝一系列新的彩票分銷設備，所有這些設備皆設計用以推動其客戶的責任性同店銷售成長。

在提供彩票服務的同時，本公司積極協助許多客戶制定成長策略。根據契約類型及司法管轄區的不同，本公司也提供行銷服務，包括零售優化及彩票品牌知名度提升活動。本公司與其彩票客戶及零售商密切合作，協助零售商更有效地銷售彩票遊戲。這些方案包括產品展示及陳列建議、每個據點適當的彩票產品組合選擇，以及帳戶審查以規劃彩票銷售成長策略。本公司利用多年來作為義大利 Lotto 及義大利 Scratch & Win (Gratta e Vinci) 即開票彩票獨家授權經銷商的經驗，這兩者是全球最大的彩票之一。這在義大利的 B2C 彩票專業知識，包含管理彩票價值鏈上所有活動，使本公司能更好地服務 B2B 客戶。

本公司提供一套完整的 iLottery 生態系統，用以協助政府監管的彩票與玩家透過整合的數位通路互動。我們的 iLottery 解決方案以我們專有的、基於雲端的遠端遊戲伺服器 ('RGS') 及我們的 OMNIA™ 整合式彩票解決方案為核心，這些解決方案促進數位遊戲組合的高性能交付，組合包含超過 200 項 eInstant 系列遊戲、數位抽獎遊戲及高品質授權內容。透過我們的 'Connected Play' 計畫，本公司提供一個跨通路體驗，透過通用 eWallet、行動領獎及二次機會計畫，連結零售與數位環境。此外，本公司運用人工智慧及預測分析—特別是透過其遊戲推薦引擎—以優化玩家參與度並個人化內容交付。此數位基礎設施設計用以符合全球各司法管轄區的嚴格監管要求，並 incorporates 高度的責任性遊戲保障措施，包括 AI 驅動的玩家行為監測，以確保安全且合規的運作環境。
目前，本公司在全球擁有 15 家平台客戶，這些客戶同時也接收 eInstant 及/或抽獎遊戲。

paragraphs: Brightstar 是全球彩券領域的領導者，專注於創新與前瞻性的策略與解決方案，建立在本公司在提供安全科技與可靠、完整的解決方案方面的知名專業之上。作為一家純彩券全球公司，本公司最佳等級的彩券運營、零售與數位解決方案，以及獲獎的彩券遊戲，使客戶得以實現目標，負責任地娛樂玩家，並向社區分發有意義的福利。Brightstar 在當地擁有穩固的據點，並被全球政府與監管機構視為值得信賴的夥伴，透過遵循最高標準的服務、誠信與責任，創造價值。
本公司運營並提供一整套創新彩券解決方案，包括彩券管理服務與即開彩券系統。本公司運營全球性的實體彩券與 iLottery 商業，包括銷售、運營、產品開發、科技與支援，並為全球首屈一指的 iLottery 平台供應商。本公司受到中央企業支援功能的支持，包括財務、人力與文化、法律、企業通訊與策略與企業發展。

2025 年，Brightstar Lottery 完成其轉型為純粹的全球彩券運營商，於 2025 年 7 月 1 日出售 IGT Gaming 後實現。我們 2025 年的營運結果主要受以下因素影響：(i) 義大利 Lotto 許可證的續約以及由此產生的 upfront license fee 滿額攤銷增加、(ii) 美國多州頭獎活動導致 LMA 動機收入減少、(iii) 即時彩券及抽獎遊戲銷售持續成長，以及 (iv) 執行 OPtiMa 3 重整計畫以重新調整我們的成本結構。
我們以強勁的流動性結算 2025 年，反映嚴謹的資本配置、出售後的債務減少，以及透過股息與股票回購將資本回饋給股東。

headings: 與本公司業務及產業相關之風險
本公司擁有集中式客戶羣，若失去任何主要客戶（或這些客戶之銷售額減少），可能會導致營業收入顯著下降。
本公司之營運依賴於持續維持並延長現有契約，並與客戶簽訂新契約之能力。
彩券產業為一競爭產業，本公司之成功 largely 依賴於其獲取長期彩券契約之能力。
來自其他類似娛樂形式之競爭，以及向數位通路轉移，可能會對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司因未能履行契約而面臨重大處罰風險。
本公司使用人工智慧、機器學習、資料科學及類似技術，可能會導致聲譽損害、競爭力下降、法律責任及對營運結果產生不利影響。
若本公司無法保護其智慧財產權或防止第三方未經授權使用，其在彩券市場的競爭能力可能受到損害。
若本公司無法自第三方取得智慧財產權授權，其在彩券市場的競爭能力可能受到損害。
第三方對本公司的智慧財產權侵權聲請，可能限制其有效競爭的能力。
本公司若無法成功完成、整合或運用策略聯盟，可能限制其未來成長，或對其持續營運造成幹擾。
出售資產可能對本公司的財務狀況、營運成果或現金流造成重大不利影響。
本公司面臨與社交媒體使用相關的聲譽風險。
本公司面臨與其營運所適用之廣泛且複雜政府規範相關的風險。
貿易規範、配額、進口稅或關稅的變更，可能對本公司服務及產品的客戶需求造成重大不利影響。
政府機構及執照機關的調查，可能導致不利的調查結果或負面宣傳。
未能遵守資料隱私權法規，包括《通用資料保護規則》（GDPR），可能導致重大處罰。
本公司面臨因違反反貪污法規及制裁計畫而產生的重大風險。
彩券產業的負面觀感與宣傳，可能導致增加的監管措施。
美國及外國稅法的變更，可能對本公司造成不利影響。
本公司可能因進行中的監管、稅務或其他法律程序而面臨不利的結果，這可能導致重大財務損失或其他對本公司造成的損害。
本公司面臨與氣候變遷相關的實體風險，以及與政府及社會對氣候變遷回應相關的過渡風險。
本公司依賴其供應商，並面臨供應鏈風險，這些風險可能對其財務結果產生不利影響。
本公司及其營運面臨網路攻擊及網路安全風險，這些風險可能對其業務及營運結果產生不利影響，並導致增加成本以降低這些風險。
未能吸引、留住並激勵人才，可能對本公司的競爭能力產生不利影響。
本公司的業務前景及未來成功高度依賴其員工、董事及代理人之誠信。
本公司的業務成功取決於客戶對本公司產品及系統之誠信的信心。
科技故障可能幹擾本公司的業務，並對其營運結果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列風險應與「第 5 項 業務與財務審閱及展望」、本年度報告所包含之合併財務報表（包括其附註）以及根據 1995 年私人證券訴訟改革法案之預測性陳述避風港條款所描述之其他風險一併考量。這些風險可能影響本公司的營運成果，並可能使實際結果與過去及預期未來結果有重大差異。下列風險討論可能包含預測性陳述，並意圖受避風港聲明之覆蓋。除非法律另有要求，本公司不負有公開更新預測性陳述之義務，無論係因新資訊、未來事件或其他原因。本公司邀請您參閱母公司不時於向 SEC 擬備或提供之資料中所作之相關揭露。
本公司營收之相當大一部分來自 ADM 所頒發之獨家授權，ADM 為意大利遊戲監管與督導之政府機構。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日，本公司總合併營收約有 18% 來自於為運作意大利 Lotto 遊戲所提供之服務，約有 19% 及 17% 來自於為運作意大利 Scratch & Win (Gratta e Vinci) 即時票券遊戲所提供之服務。

本公司預期其營收與利潤將持續依賴 ADM 所頒發之授權。這些授權不可續約，且在發生影響本公司之特定違約事件時，可能在到期日前被終止，或若認為這些授權違反公共利益，或被競爭對手成功挑戰而終止或撤銷。此外，任何新授權之條件將由法律規定並包含於新授權之規則中。若本公司來自這些授權之營收有重大減少，包括因這些授權到期後被撤銷、提前終止或未續約所致，已對本公司營運成果、業務、財務狀況或展望造成重大不利影響，並可能在未來繼續造成重大不利影響。
此外，本公司於義大利以外的前十大客戶所產生的持續性營業收入，約佔其截至2025年12月31日財年總合併營業收入之35%。2025年8月，我們義大利以外的歷史前十大客戶之一Allwyn UK，完成其英國彩券系統轉移至另一供應商，因而導致失去一位客戶，該客戶在2025年及2024年分別產生約37 百萬美元及54 百萬美元的營業收入。
此外，若本公司之一家或多家主要客戶銷售額低於預期，可能對本公司造成重大不利影響。例如，LMAs 包含基於績效的激勵機制，若達成特定契約指標，本公司可能獲得額外付款；若未達成則可能產生短額付款。2025 年，激勵付款變動減少 51 百萬美元，主要由於 MSJP 活動減少。
若本公司失去任何其他主要客戶，或這些主要客戶銷售減少導致營收減少，而這些營收主要為服務營收，則可能對本公司營運成果、業務、財務狀況或展望造成重大不利影響。
